title: VP-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Visual Prompting in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Introducing 'debias' multiple-choice questions where the visual prompt mentioned in the query is either entirely absent from the image or all substantive descriptive answer choices are incorrect. This evaluates whether the model hallucinates the presence of a visual prompt just because it is asked about it.

Comparing model perception accuracy across different visual prompt shapes to reveal performance disparities. The evaluation tests if models are biased toward recognizing regular geometric forms (e.g., bounding boxes, tags, ovals) over irregular or less common shapes (e.g., masks, hand-drawn scribbles) due to skewed training data distributions.
